narr: Locally heavy rain showers produced as much as 2 to 5 inches of rain in parts of New Castle County on the afternoon of August 17.
ev: Old Ogletown Road near Ogletown was closed due to flooding.
US Route 40 in Glasgow was inundated with flood waters near DE Route 72.
Minor flooding occurred along the Christina River at Cooch's Bridge.
lsr: OLD OGLETOWN ROAD NEAR OGLETOWN WAS CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
US ROUTE 40 WAS INUNDATED NEAR DELAWARE ROUTE 72 TO THE EAST OF GLASGOW.
MINOR FLOODING OCCURRED ALONG THE CHRISTINA RIVER AT COOCHS BRIDGE. RIVER GAUGE REPORT.
